problem.summary: Canonical main production/test surface had advanced beyond the historical committed build certificate, and raw-byte certification was not portable across Git clients with different autocrlf settings.

rejected_attempt.reason: Machine B correctly failed structural verify because checkout CRLF conversion changed raw certified file bytes. Candidate was not promoted.

portability_repair.git_policy: factory/.gitattributes pins LF for certified JSON/Markdown/Python/shell/text/version files.

machine_b.note: Structural manifest verification and full tests are required before promotion. Full preflight may remain runtime-lock blocked because the canonical runtime lock is Python 3.12.13.

authority_boundary: This change repairs mechanical certification freshness and cross-machine byte portability for the already-canonical extraction-factory surface. It does not authorize production effects, provider access, semantic model certification, or any unrelated repository.
